pages.text: The basic $(thing)Wooden Smoking Pipe$() is a custom 3×3 recipe. Use any two Planks and two Sticks in this exact pattern:$(br2)$(item)__P$()$(br)$(item)_PS$()$(br)$(item)S__$()$(br2)P = any Plank, S = Stick, _ = empty. The pipe remembers the first plank type and uses it in the pipe's name/appearance.

To pack a pipe, hold an $(thing)empty pipe in your offhand$() and $(thing)loose tobacco in your main hand$(), then right-click with the tobacco. One loose tobacco is consumed and the pipe receives $(item)40 puffs$().
pages.title: Packing

pages.text: Right-click a packed pipe to take one puff. When its 40 puffs are exhausted, the pipe becomes empty and can be packed again. The durability-style bar and tooltip show how much tobacco remains.
pages.title: Smoking

pages.text: The decorative pipe variants use the same packing/smoking behavior as the wooden pipe unless their tooltip says otherwise. Loose tobacco processing data is copied into the packed pipe so quality/aging bonuses can still be evaluated when smoked.
pages.title: Shared Behavior
